name: ai-coding-mentor
description: AI Real-Time Coding Screener - A web app that watches learner code and provides progressive hints

scripts.check: npm run check:backend && npm run check:frontend
scripts.check:backend: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check . && uv run mypy .
scripts.check:frontend: cd frontend && pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm format:check
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend && npm run test:sandbox
scripts.test:sandbox: cd sandbox && uv run pytest tests
scripts.types: cd backend && uv run python -m app.schemas.export && cd ../frontend && pnpm json-schema-to-typescript
scripts.db:migrate: cd backend && uv run alembic upgrade head
scripts.dev:backend: cd backend && uv run uvicorn app.main:app --reload --port 8000
scripts.eval: cd eval && uv run python harness/run_eval.py
scripts.bench: cd eval && uv run python harness/bench_latency.py
scripts.setup: npm run setup:backend && npm run setup:frontend && npm run setup:sandbox && npm run setup:eval
scripts.clean: npm run clean:backend && npm run clean:frontend && npm run clean:sandbox

*.py: cd backend && uv run ruff format
cd backend && uv run ruff check --fix
